scope: Finite confidence region under explicit nuisance envelopes; analytic information lower bound for unrestricted persistence; no original-gap qualification

checks.subject: Observed summaries
checks.finding: Action undoing, candidate average and audited candidate difference derived from available observations; K squared cancels order and common calendar cancels from H. Persistent multiplier moments are exact.

checks.subject: Unknown-nuisance inference
checks.finding: B normal variance envelope, inverted-binomial rank interval and Chebyshev numerator inversion give union-bound coverage without plugging in estimated error or assuming component independence. Bounds must be declared or have their own proved coverage budget.

checks.subject: Quadratic and projection
checks.finding: Leading coefficient and strict common rank margin derived. Rank near zero or negative leading coefficient yields unbounded tails; projection must retain topology and numerical outer containment.

checks.subject: Calendar lower bound
checks.finding: Known-covariance exact-identity submodel makes experiment easier. AR1 precision sum and equal-covariance Gaussian total variation produce nonvanishing diameter along rho=1-1/T^2. Pointwise fixed-rho asymptotics are not contradicted.

checks.subject: Scope and predecessors
checks.finding: No data/threshold rerun. Exact deterministic checks only. Chebyshev failing width is construction-specific, not a universal impossibility. Fixed .95 predecessor failures remain separate.

evidence.anchor: Executed deterministic references, zero random draws
Preserved final screen and observation-law assumptions
Inspected predecessor feasible score and oracle variance distinction

limitations: No numerical implementation of continuum confidence-set projection.
Nuisance envelopes and representative gold mechanism are additional substantive inputs.
Finite availability fails for the conservative candidate in representative predecessor settings.
No independent review, final study approval, bank truth or product capability.
